title: Coordinates: Chapter Introduction
subject: Mathematics
objective: Two numbers pin any seat in an exam hall, and any point on a plane: coordinates turn geometry into numbers.

fill.q: The horizontal number line in the coordinate plane is the ____.
The axes meet at the ____, whose coordinates are (0, 0).
In (x, y), the first number tells the distance along the ____.
The axes divide the plane into four ____.

tf.explain: Order matters: (x, y) is an ordered pair.

tf.q: Every point on the y-axis has x-coordinate 0.
tf.explain: It is zero steps along the x-axis.

tf.q: A point in quadrant IV has a positive y-coordinate.

short.solution: Start at O, move 3 units left along the x-axis (x is negative), then 2 units up parallel to the y-axis. The point lies in quadrant II.

short.q: Why is "row 3, seat 5" like a coordinate?
short.solution: Two numbers measured along two fixed directions from a fixed start locate exactly one seat, just as (x, y) locates one point.

match.explain: Each sign pattern matches its quadrant.
